1.web: A prayer of Habakkuk, the prophet, set to victorious music.
1.asv: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, set to Shigionoth.

2.web: Yahweh, I have heard of your fame. I stand in awe of your deeds, Yahweh. Renew your work in the midst of the years. In the midst of the years make it known. In wrath, you remember mercy.
2.asv: O Jehovah, I have heard the report of thee, and am afraid: O Jehovah, revive thy work in the midst of the years; In the midst of the years make it known; In wrath remember mercy.

3.web: God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and his praise filled the earth.
3.asv: God came from Teman, And the Holy One from mount Paran. [Selah His glory covered the heavens, And the earth was full of his praise.

4.web: His splendor is like the sunrise. Rays shine from his hand, where his power is hidden.
4.asv: Andhisbrightness was as the light; He had rayscoming forthfrom his hand; And there was the hiding of his power.

5.web: Plague went before him, and pestilence followed his feet.
5.asv: Before him went the pestilence, And fiery bolts went forth at his feet.

6.web: He stood, and shook the earth. He looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains were crumbled. The age-old hills collapsed. His ways are eternal.
6.asv: He stood, and measured the earth; He beheld, and drove asunder the nations; And the eternal mountains were scattered; The everlasting hills did bow; His goings were as of old.

7.web: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction. The dwellings of the land of Midian trembled.
7.asv: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction; The curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.

8.web: Was Yahweh displeased with the rivers? Was your anger against the rivers, or your wrath against the sea, that you rode on your horses, on your chariots of salvation?
8.asv: Was Jehovah displeased with the rivers? Was thine anger against the rivers, Or thy wrath against the sea, That thou didst ride upon thy horses, Upon thy chariots of salvation?

9.web: You uncovered your bow. You called for your sworn arrows. Selah. You split the earth with rivers.
9.asv: Thy bow was made quite bare; The oaths to the tribes were asure word. [Selah Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.

10.web: The mountains saw you, and were afraid. The storm of waters passed by. The deep roared and lifted up its hands on high.
10.asv: The mountains saw thee, and were afraid; The tempest of waters passed by; The deep uttered its voice, And lifted up its hands on high.

11.web: The sun and moon stood still in the sky, at the light of your arrows as they went, at the shining of your glittering spear.
11.asv: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation, At the light of thine arrows as they went, At the shining of thy glittering spear.

12.web: You marched through the land in wrath. You threshed the nations in anger.
12.asv: Thou didst march through the land in indignation; Thou didst thresh the nations in anger.

13.web: You went out for the salvation of your people, for the salvation of your anointed. You crushed the head of the land of wickedness. You stripped them head to foot. Selah.
13.asv: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, For the salvation of thine anointed; Thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked man, Laying bare the foundation even unto the neck. [Selah

14.web: You pierced the heads of his warriors with their own spears. They came as a whirlwind to scatter me, gloating as if to devour the wretched in secret.
14.asv: Thou didst pierce with his own staves the head of his warriors: They came as a whirlwind to scatter me; Their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.

15.web: You trampled the sea with your horses, churning mighty waters.
15.asv: Thou didst tread the sea with thy horses, The heap of mighty waters.

16.web: I heard, and my body trembled. My lips quivered at the voice. Rottenness enters into my bones, and I tremble in my place, because I must wait quietly for the day of trouble, for the coming up of the people who invade us.
16.asv: I heard, and my body trembled, My lips quivered at the voice; Rottenness entereth into my bones, and I tremble in my place; Because I must wait quietly for the day of trouble, For the coming up of the people that invadeth us.

17.web: For though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines; the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no food; the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls:
17.asv: For though the fig-tree shall not flourish, Neither shall fruit be in the vines; The labor of the olive shall fail, And the fields shall yield no food; The flock shall be cut off from the fold, And there shall be no herd in the stalls:

18.web: yet I will rejoice in Yahweh. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!
18.asv: Yet I will rejoice in Jehovah, I will joy in the God of my salvation.

19.web: Yahweh, the Lord, is my strength. He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and enables me to go in high places. For the music director, on my stringed instruments.
19.asv: Jehovah, the Lord, is my strength; And he maketh my feet like hinds’ feet, And will make me to walk upon my high places.
